name: 1Password API Patterns
description: 1Password MCP fundamentals through Conduit: the region plus two independent credential halves (Events Reporting token, Users API client) and their X-OnePassword-* headers, which of the six read-only tools needs which half, which three are admin-gated in Conduit, cursor paging on the Events feeds, page-token paging on users, time windows and 120-day retention, rate limits, and how vendor errors come back.
